refill.why: Good Welsh, but only one USE is needed and 'seeing the end of the village' reads oddly next to U05
Not wanting to 'see the end of the village' in bad weather is a strange idea, and only one slot is needed

Strange meaning, and the reported-speech Korean could also map to a 'fod hi ddim' variant
Searching for the end of a village is unnatural, and plural 'gadewch i ni' against Korean -자 doesn't settle which form is meant
Semantically odd ('want to see the end of the village with him')
Semantically odd. 'mynd i weld' is a weak fit for 볼 거야, and only one slot is needed
